<!doctype html><html lang="uk"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><title>Survival Atlas — інтерактивний довідник</title><style>:root {--bg:#0c1511;--surface:#17231c;--surface2:#1d2b22;--edge:#364536;--text:#f5f5ed;--muted:#b4c1b3;--accent:#eaa350;--accent-ink:#1a2018;--good:#9fdb91;--danger:#f5a58d; color-scheme:dark}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;padding:0;min-height:100%;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:Roboto,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55}body{overscroll-behavior-y:contain}button,input{font:inherit}button{color:inherit;cursor:pointer;appearance:none;border:0;background:transparent;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}button:active{opacity:.82}button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}h1,h2,h3,p{margin:0}img{display:block;object-fit:cover}#app{min-height:100dvh}.screen{padding-bottom:calc(70px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));min-height:calc(100dvh - 65px)}.page-screen{padding-top:18px}.content{padding-left:16px;padding-right:16px}
.app-header{height:60px;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top);height:calc(60px + env(safe-area-inset-top));display:grid;grid-template-columns:53px 1fr 53px;align-items:center;background:#101b15;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(235,239,220,.11)}.top-icon{font-size:29px;display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:52px;color:var(--accent)}.header-title{text-align:center;line-height:1.14}.header-title span{font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1.9px;color:#cfa972;display:block}.header-title strong{font-size:15px;display:block;margin-top:4px}.bottom-nav{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:30;background:#111d16;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);height:calc(61px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));padding:4px 2px env(safe-area-inset-bottom);border-top:1px solid #384538;margin:0}.nav-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;color:#abb6a8}.nav-item.active{color:var(--accent)}.nav-item span{font-size:25px;line-height:27px}.nav-item small{font-size:10px;font-weight:750}
.cover{position:relative;height:240px;overflow:hidden;background:#263429}.cover-image{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-position:center 44%}.cover-scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(3,11,8,.95),rgba(3,11,8,.21) 78%)}.cover-copy{position:absolute;left:19px;right:15px;bottom:17px}.cover-copy small{display:block;color:#ffc77b;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1.4px;margin-bottom:6px}.cover-copy h1{font-size:27px;line-height:1.13;letter-spacing:-.6px;max-width:340px}.cover-copy p{color:#e2e9da;font-size:12px;margin-top:8px;max-width:350px;line-height:1.42}.home-cover{height:219px}.home-cover .cover-copy h1{font-size:32px}.category-cover{height:223px}.article-cover{height:286px}.species-cover{height:251px}
.section-title{font-size:20px;line-height:1.2;margin:22px 0 12px;letter-spacing:-.2px}.section-subtitle{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:-4px 0 14px}.menu-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:18px}.menu-card{height:153px;position:relative;display:block;overflow:hidden;border-radius:14px;background:#273728;text-align:left;border:1px solid rgba(230,244,220,.14)}.menu-card>img{width:100%;height:100%;filter:saturate(.88) contrast(1.1)}.menu-shade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 14%,rgba(5,14,9,.2) 39%,rgba(4,10,7,.98) 100%)}.menu-copy{position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:10px;right:9px}.menu-copy b{display:block;font-size:15px;line-height:1.15;padding-right:10px}.menu-copy small{display:block;font-size:10px;line-height:1.23;color:#d3ddd0;margin-top:5px}.menu-arrow{position:absolute;right:9px;top:3px;font-size:23px;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 0 4px #000}.quick-section{margin:22px 0 0}.quick-heading{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between}.quick-heading b{font-size:18px}.quick-heading button{color:var(--accent);font-weight:800;font-size:12px}.link-list,.topic-list{display:grid;gap:10px;margin:15px 0}.article-link{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:left;background:var(--surface);border-radius:13px;border:1px solid var(--edge);padding:0 11px 0 0;min-height:88px;overflow:hidden}.article-thumb{width:94px;height:90px;flex:0 0 94px}.article-link-content{flex:1;padding:9px 0;min-width:0}.article-link-content b{font-size:14px;line-height:1.25;display:block}.article-link-content small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;line-height:1.25;margin-top:6px}.article-link-arrow{font-size:25px;color:var(--accent)}
.crumbs{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:#aebcae;font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.7;padding:11px 0 8px}.crumbs button{color:#f0b767;padding:0;text-align:left;font-size:inherit}.crumbs b{color:#cfdbc9;font-weight:650}.page-screen .crumbs{padding:0 0 21px}.kicker{font-size:10px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:1.3px;color:var(--accent)}.page-title{font-size:30px;line-height:1.18;margin:6px 0 9px;letter-spacing:-.6px}.intro{font-size:13px;color:#bfcebe;margin-bottom:21px}.topic-card{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;text-align:left;padding:13px 12px;border:1px solid #394b3b;border-radius:13px;background:var(--surface);min-height:88px}.topic-icon{width:39px;height:43px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#2b3a2d;color:#e6bd7f;font-size:21px;flex:0 0 39px;border-radius:10px}.topic-card>div:nth-child(2){flex:1}.topic-card strong{font-size:15px}.topic-card p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.35;margin-top:4px}.topic-card small{display:block;color:var(--accent);font-size:10px;margin-top:5px}.topic-card>span:last-child{color:var(--accent);font-size:25px}.segmented{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;padding:2px 0 7px;scrollbar-width:none;margin-top:15px}.segmented button{white-space:nowrap;border-radius:18px;padding:7px 12px;font-size:11px;background:#28372c;border:1px solid #3b503d}.segmented button.on{background:var(--accent);color:#171a12;font-weight:850}.image-unavailable{width:100%;height:100%;background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,#28352a,#28352a 12px,#202e24 12px,#202e24 24px);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:10px;color:#d4c5aa;text-align:center;font-size:10px}.article-link .image-unavailable{width:94px;height:90px;flex:0 0 94px}.status{font-weight:800;font-size:11px;display:block}.status.safe{color:var(--good)}.status.danger{color:var(--danger)}.status.warn{color:var(--accent)}.status.neutral{color:#b5cee7}.article-link-content .latin{font-style:italic;margin-top:2px}
.article-content{padding-top:5px}.article-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:9px;margin:17px 0 8px;color:#a6b3a3;font-size:11px}.bookmark{font-weight:850;font-size:12px;color:var(--accent);border:1px solid #725a3c;border-radius:10px;padding:7px 10px}.bookmark.saved{color:var(--good);border-color:#4e7a4c}.article-section{padding:17px 0 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #314336}.article-section h2{font-size:19px;line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 13px;color:#f1e9d4}.article-section>p{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.65;color:#d2ddce}.materials-list{margin:0;padding:0 0 0 20px}.materials-list li{margin:7px 0;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.55;color:#e1e9dc}.materials-list li::marker{color:var(--accent)}.muted-box{background:#202e23;border:1px solid #41533b;padding:13px;margin-top:14px;border-radius:11px;font-size:12px!important;color:#cadac5!important;line-height:1.6}.readable-step{padding:16px 0 18px;border-bottom:1px solid #324032}.readable-step:last-child{border-bottom:0}.step-heading{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin:0 0 12px}.step-heading>span{display:grid;place-items:center;width:32px;height:32px;flex:0 0 32px;border-radius:10px;background:#c97e30;color:#20180c;font-weight:900;font-size:13px}.step-heading h3{font-size:16px;line-height:1.3;padding-top:4px}.readable-step>p{color:#d5ded2;line-height:1.67;font-size:13.5px}.step-image{max-width:100%;width:100%;height:190px;border-radius:11px;margin:5px 0 13px}.step-observation{background:#1b2a20;border-left:3px solid #759c74;border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;padding:11px 12px;margin-top:13px}.step-observation b{font-size:11px;color:#b7d8ad}.step-observation p{font-size:12px;color:#cbd9c8;margin-top:4px}.note{display:flex;gap:10px;margin:16px 0 22px;border-radius:12px;background:#213025;border:1px solid #4b624c;padding:13px}.note>span{width:23px;height:23px;flex:0 0 23px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:#527451;color:#f5f8ea;font-weight:900}.note>p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:#d7e4d4}.note.alert{background:#30261d;border-color:#74533d}.note.alert>span{background:#d28b47;color:#17130e}.article-end{padding:0 13px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;padding-left:5px}.safety-list li::marker{color:var(--accent);font-weight:850}.empty{padding:30px 14px;text-align:center;border:1px dashed #4c604c;color:#b9c7b7;border-radius:13px}.searchbox{display:flex;align-items:center;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid #5c7559;background:#243329;padding:0 14px;height:53px;margin:15px 0}.searchbox span{font-size:26px;color:var(--accent)}.searchbox input{flex:1;min-width:0;background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--text);font-size:14px;outline:0;margin-left:10px}.search-hint{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:16px}.species-link .status{font-size:10px}
@media (min-width:700px){.content{max-width:670px;margin:0 auto}.cover{max-width:670px;margin:0 auto}.app-header,.bottom-nav{padding-left:max(0px,calc((100% - 670px)/2));padding-right:max(0px,calc((100% - 670px)/2))}.home-screen .menu-card{height:190px}.article-cover{height:360px}.screen{min-height:calc(100dvh - 60px)}}

.related-topics{margin:24px 0 14px;padding-top:1px;border-top:1px solid #334836}.related-topics .section-title{font-size:16px;color:#d7decf}.related-topics .topic-card{min-height:72px}.related-topics .topic-card p{font-size:11px}

/* Survival Atlas 9 — compact three-level reading experience */
#app{min-height:100dvh}
.screen{min-height:0;padding-bottom:calc(82px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
.app-header.v9-header{grid-template-columns:55px 1fr 55px;height:calc(62px + env(safe-area-inset-top));background:#0d1912;box-shadow:0 3px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.v9-header .top-icon{min-height:53px;line-height:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.atlas-logo{width:38px;height:38px;display:block;flex-shrink:0;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4))}
.atlas-logo.atlas-logo-large{width:90px;height:90px;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.7))}
.v9-header .header-title strong{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.1px}.v9-header .header-title span{letter-spacing:1.3px;font-size:8px}
.bottom-nav.v9-bottom{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);height:calc(63px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));padding:3px 2px env(safe-area-inset-bottom);box-shadow:0 -4px 17px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.v9-bottom .nav-item span{font-size:25px}
.v9-home-hero{position:relative;height:278px;overflow:hidden;background:#1e2e24;max-width:670px;margin:auto}
.v9-home-hero .cover-image{filter:saturate(.95) contrast(1.1)}
.v9-home-hero .cover-scrim{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(5,15,10,.12),rgba(4,14,9,.55) 25%,rgba(4,14,9,.91) 100%)}
.v9-hero-content{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:25px 17px;text-align:center}
.v9-brand-name{font-weight:950;font-size:31px;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:1px;color:#f7f0dd;margin:7px 0 4px;text-shadow:0 2px 12px #061008}
.v9-brand-name span{color:#efb36c}
.v9-hero-content p{font-size:12.5px;color:#e3e9df;max-width:255px;line-height:1.4;margin:0 0 12px}
.v9-offline{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#bbdcb5;border:1px solid rgba(176,206,165,.35);padding:5px 12px;border-radius:30px;background:rgba(20,43,23,.75)}
.v9-intro-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:5px}
.v9-intro-row span{font-size:11px;color:#c6b490;background:#243629;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:20px}
.v9-intro-row .section-title{margin:17px 0 7px}
.v9-menu-grid{gap:11px}
.v9-menu-card{height:158px;border-color:#4c5c48;border-radius:13px;transition:transform .15s}
.v9-menu-card .menu-shade{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(4,10,7,.02) 5%,rgba(4,13,8,.42) 42%,rgba(3,10,6,.95) 100%)}
.v9-menu-card .menu-copy{left:12px;bottom:11px;right:10px}
.v9-menu-card .menu-copy em{font-style:normal;display:block;font-size:23px;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:3px;text-shadow:0 2px 3px #000}
.v9-menu-card .menu-copy b{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.12}
.v9-menu-card .menu-copy small{font-size:10.5px;color:#c4d1bd;margin-top:6px}
.v9-featured{padding:5px 0 0;margin:17px 0 16px;border-top:1px solid #314435}
.v9-featured .quick-heading b{font-size:18px}
.v9-theme-hero .category-cover{height:218px}
.v9-theme-count{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:11.5px;color:#d9c39b;background:#1d2b22;border-radius:9px;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid #3b4b39}
.v9-theme-count>span{font-size:20px}
.v9-list-title{font-size:18px;margin:21px 0 10px}
.v9-article-link{min-height:91px;border-color:#405342}
.v9-article-link .article-link-arrow{font-size:25px}
.v9-article-link .article-link-content small{margin-top:5px}
.v9-article-link .latin{font-style:italic}
.v9-safety-link{padding-left:12px}
.risk-mark{height:54px;width:54px;flex:0 0 54px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#a16b34,#4b3927);color:#ffe1a0;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:12px;font-size:27px;font-weight:900}
.v9-theme-hero .cover-copy h1{font-size:28px}
.article-toolbar .status{font-size:11px}
.page-screen{padding-top:14px}
.article-end{margin:20px 0 4px;padding:0 0 10px}
.article-end button{line-height:1.4}
@media(min-width:700px){.v9-menu-card{height:194px}.v9-home-hero{height:305px}}


/* Survival Atlas 10.0: editorial illustrations and expanded thematic atlas */
.v9-menu-grid {grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px}
.v9-menu-card{height:162px}
.v9-menu-card img{filter:saturate(.97) contrast(1.05)}
.v9-menu-card .menu-copy b{font-size:15px;line-height:1.19}
.v9-menu-card .menu-copy small{font-size:11px}
.v9-intro-row span{padding:3px 9px;border:1px solid #5c684b;border-radius:20px;color:#d5c292;background:#223128;font-weight:750;font-size:11px}
.atlas-figure{margin:12px 0 17px}
.atlas-figure .step-image{height:auto;aspect-ratio:1000/340;object-fit:contain;background:#0b1b16;border:1px solid #526850;border-radius:12px;margin:0}
.atlas-figure figcaption{font-size:11px;color:#9fb09e;margin:7px 2px 0}
.v9-home-hero:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#08150f66,transparent)}
@media(min-width:700px){.v9-menu-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.v9-menu-card{height:194px}}

/* Atlas 10.2 editorial water reference extras */
.atlas-quickfacts{display:grid;gap:9px;margin-top:12px}
.atlas-quickfacts>div{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start;background:#20352a;border:1px solid #4d7356;border-radius:11px;padding:12px 13px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;color:#f5f3e8}
.atlas-quickfacts>div>span{color:#e1b66f;font-weight:900;font-size:15px;flex:none}
.atlas-table-scroll{overflow-x:auto;margin:14px 0;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid #4b6756}
.atlas-ref-table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55}
.atlas-ref-table td,.atlas-ref-table th{border-bottom:1px solid #385449;padding:12px 9px;vertical-align:top;text-align:left;min-width:90px}
.atlas-ref-table th{font-weight:750;color:#eec27d;background:#20372c;min-width:140px}
.atlas-ref-table td{color:#e0ebe1;background:#182d24}
.atlas-ref-table tr:last-child td,.atlas-ref-table tr:last-child th{border-bottom:0}
.article-screen .article-cover .cover-image{object-fit:cover;background:#132a22}
.atlas-figure{margin:12px 0 15px;border:1px solid #3e604e;background:#102a24;border-radius:13px;overflow:hidden}
.atlas-figure .step-image{width:100%;max-height:260px;object-fit:contain;background:#14281e}
.atlas-figure figcaption{padding:8px 12px;color:#a6bea9;font-size:11px;background:#1d352a}
@media(max-width:380px){.atlas-ref-table{font-size:12px}.atlas-ref-table th,.atlas-ref-table td{padding:10px 7px}}

.atlas-reference-head{padding:28px 18px 25px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#172b21,#0d1c15);border-bottom:1px solid #516448}
.atlas-reference-head h1{font-size:25px;line-height:1.19;margin:9px 0 10px;font-weight:850;color:#f8f5e8}
.atlas-reference-head p{font-size:14px;color:#bbcebd;line-height:1.55}
.atlas-reference-kicker{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.1px;color:#e6b66f}
.atlas-full-diagram{margin:8px 0 18px;border:1px solid #45614e;background:#112a22;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}
.atlas-full-diagram img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;object-fit:contain;aspect-ratio:16/9}
.atlas-full-diagram figcaption{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:7px;padding:9px 10px;background:#1a3328;color:#abbfac;font-size:11px}
.atlas-full-diagram button,.atlas-figure button{background:#324e3b;color:#f4d5a0;border:1px solid #648266;border-radius:8px;padding:5px 7px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;flex:none}
.atlas-figure figcaption{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.atlas-zoom-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1000;background:#06110a;display:flex;flex-direction:column;color:#f6f8ec}
.atlas-zoom-bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:14px 15px;gap:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #4e6352}
.atlas-zoom-bar strong{font-size:15px;line-height:1.3}
.atlas-zoom-close{font-size:25px;padding:4px 11px;border:1px solid #6d7b69;border-radius:7px}
.atlas-zoom-scroll{overflow:auto;flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start}
.atlas-zoom-scroll img{width:960px;min-width:960px;height:auto;max-height:none;object-fit:contain;user-select:none}
.atlas-zoom-overlay>p{padding:12px 15px;color:#b5c8bb;font-size:12px;border-top:1px solid #435747}
@media(min-width:970px){.atlas-zoom-scroll{justify-content:center}}

/* Version 10.5: real-looking illustrations are embedded into the app. */
.atlas-figure .step-image {aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;height:auto;border-radius:11px}
.atlas-full-diagram img {aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;height:auto}
.atlas-zoom-scroll {justify-content:center; padding:8px;}
.atlas-zoom-scroll img {width:auto;min-width:0;max-width:100%;max-height:calc(100dvh - 136px);height:auto;object-fit:contain;border-radius:8px}
.atlas-zoom-overlay>p {text-align:center}
@media(max-width:420px){.atlas-full-diagram figcaption{flex-wrap:wrap}.atlas-full-diagram figcaption button{margin-left:auto}}

/* Water article photos are captioned and display at natural aspect ratio without magnifying crops. */
.article-screen .atlas-figure .step-image {width:100%;height:auto;max-height:none;aspect-ratio:auto;object-fit:contain;background:#10241c;}
.article-screen .atlas-figure figcaption {align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;line-height:1.45;font-size:12px;}
.article-screen .atlas-figure figcaption span{flex:1;min-width:0;}
@media(max-width:390px){.article-screen .atlas-figure figcaption button{white-space:nowrap;}}

/* Photo-led instructions: only Water guides use the new image treatment. */
.atlas-figure.atlas-photo-sequence .step-image{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:none;aspect-ratio:auto;object-fit:contain;border:0;border-radius:0;background:#11271e;}
.atlas-figure.atlas-photo-sequence{background:#11271e;border-color:#4a705b;}
.atlas-figure.atlas-photo-sequence figcaption{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;}

/* Single article photo instructions: no stretching/cropping; other articles unchanged. */
.water-search-article .atlas-figure .step-image{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:none;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:contain;background:#10221a;border:0;border-radius:0;margin:0}
.water-search-article .atlas-figure{border:1px solid #3b5140;border-radius:13px;overflow:hidden;margin:12px 0 15px}
.water-search-article .atlas-figure figcaption{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;padding:10px 12px;color:#c9d7c9}
.water-search-article .atlas-figure button{flex-shrink:0}
.water-search-article .readable-step>p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.75;color:#e2e7da}
.water-search-article .step-observation p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}

/* Supplemental map and aerial guidance, only within this one Water article. */
.water-search-article .water-step-references{display:grid;gap:15px;margin:14px 0 18px;}
.water-search-article .water-map-reference{margin:0;background:#14291e;border:1px solid #4b634d;overflow:hidden;}
.water-search-article .water-map-reference img.step-image{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:auto;max-height:none;object-fit:contain;background:#182d21;}
.water-search-article .water-map-reference figcaption{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 13px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.water-search-article .water-map-reference figcaption span{flex:1;min-width:210px;line-height:1.6;color:#d4ded0;font-size:12px;}

/* v14: numbered articles and full-frame article illustrations */
.atlas-number-thumb{position:relative;display:block;flex:0 0 auto;overflow:hidden;border-radius:15px 0 0 15px}
.atlas-number-thumb .article-thumb{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border:0;border-radius:0}
.atlas-guide-number{position:absolute;left:7px;top:7px;min-width:32px;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:8px;color:#182a19;background:#f0b15e;font-weight:900;font-size:13px;line-height:1.1;box-shadow:0 1px 4px #09171099;letter-spacing:.02em}
.atlas-inline-number{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;margin-right:8px;color:#f0b15e;font-size:.85em;font-weight:800}
.v9-article-link .atlas-number-thumb{width:120px;height:100%;align-self:stretch;min-height:122px}
.v9-article-link .atlas-number-thumb img.article-thumb{width:100%;height:100%}
.atlas-full-diagram,.atlas-figure{border-radius:15px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #466b56}
.atlas-figure img.step-image,.atlas-full-diagram img.full-diagram{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:none;object-fit:contain}
.atlas-figure figcaption,.atlas-full-diagram figcaption{display:none!important}

/* Article 07: photographic steps and full-width portrait technical diagrams. */
.article-screen .atlas-instruction-diagram{width:100%;margin:14px 0 20px;border:1px solid #456f57;border-radius:17px;background:#10281c;overflow:hidden;}
.article-screen .atlas-instruction-diagram img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:none;aspect-ratio:auto;object-fit:contain;}

/* Preserve whole article-cover photography inside its bordered frame, without letterboxing or cropped sides. */
.article-screen .atlas-full-diagram img.full-diagram{aspect-ratio:auto!important;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:none;object-fit:contain!important;}
</style><style>
.spring-stream-article .readable-step p + p, .spring-stream-article .article-section > p + p {margin-top:12px}
.spring-stream-article .readable-step p {line-height:1.76}
.spring-stream-article .atlas-figure img {object-fit:contain;max-height:520px;background:#101a14}
.spring-stream-article .atlas-figure figcaption {line-height:1.5}

/* Atlas cleanup: no zoom labels/buttons, framed full images */
.article-toolbar{justify-content:flex-end}
.article-toolbar>span{display:none!important}
.atlas-figure,.atlas-full-diagram{margin:12px 0 16px;border:1px solid #3f5b4b;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:#10231b;box-shadow:none}
.atlas-figure figcaption,.atlas-full-diagram figcaption{display:none!important}
.atlas-figure .step-image,.atlas-full-diagram .full-diagram,.atlas-full-diagram img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:none;aspect-ratio:auto;object-fit:cover;background:#10231b;border:0;border-radius:0;margin:0}
.water-search-article .atlas-figure .step-image,.spring-stream-article .atlas-figure .step-image,.safest-source-article .atlas-figure .step-image{width:100%;height:auto;max-height:none;aspect-ratio:auto;object-fit:cover;border:0;border-radius:0;background:#10231b}
.water-search-article .water-map-reference figcaption,.spring-stream-article .water-map-reference figcaption,.safest-source-article .water-map-reference figcaption{display:none!important}

.v9-article-link .article-thumb,.article-link .article-thumb{width:122px;min-width:122px;height:122px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:0;display:block;background:#14261d;}
.v9-article-link{overflow:hidden}.v9-article-link .article-link-content{padding-right:6px;}

/* Survival Atlas — fixed 75-language foundation */
.app-header.v9-header{grid-template-columns:48px minmax(0,1fr) 42px 43px;gap:0}
.app-header.v9-header .header-title{min-width:0;overflow:hidden}
.app-header.v9-header .header-title strong{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.atlas-lang-btn{font-size:21px;min-height:48px;color:#e9b36a}
.atlas-languages-screen .searchbox{margin:16px 0 12px}
.atlas-languages-summary{margin:12px 0 5px;color:#d4e3d4;font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
.atlas-translation-warning,.atlas-translation-notice,.atlas-untranslated{font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;padding:12px 15px;color:#f2e0b9;background:#253020;border:1px solid #a28a59;border-radius:12px;margin:12px 0}
.atlas-translation-notice{margin:0;border-left:0;border-right:0;border-radius:0;padding:8px 15px;font-size:12px;text-align:center}
.atlas-language-row{display:flex;width:100%;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;text-align:left;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid #455746;background:#1a2b21;color:#edf4e9;border-radius:13px;margin-bottom:7px;min-height:60px}
.atlas-language-row.is-current{border-color:#e4ac62;background:#283d2c}
.atlas-language-row.is-pending{opacity:.53;cursor:not-allowed}
.atlas-language-name{font-size:15px;font-weight:700}
.atlas-language-name small{display:block;color:#aab9ab;font-size:11px;font-weight:400;margin-top:4px}
.atlas-language-status{flex-shrink:0;font-size:11px;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 8px;border:1px solid #617967;color:#dce9ce}
.atlas-languages-footnote{color:#a9b9aa;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;margin:15px 0 20px}
.atlas-empty{color:#a4b3a4;text-align:center;padding:26px 12px}
.atlas-translatable-diagram{overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #55755f;border-radius:15px;background:#0c2420;}
.atlas-diagram-canvas{position:relative;width:100%;overflow:hidden}
.article-screen .atlas-translatable-diagram img.step-image{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:none;aspect-ratio:auto;object-fit:contain;background:#0b231d;border-radius:0}
.atlas-visual-label{position:absolute;z-index:2;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);display:block;min-width:62px;max-width:31%;text-align:center;color:#fff0d4;background:#0d2b24ed;border:1px solid #d2a76c;border-radius:8px;padding:5px 7px;font-size:clamp(9px,2.7vw,14px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.15;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere;box-shadow:0 2px 7px #06130c55}
[dir="rtl"] .atlas-language-row,[dir="rtl"] .atlas-language-row .atlas-language-name{text-align:right}
[dir="rtl"] .atlas-language-row{direction:rtl}

/* Water 36: fully offline step decision maps and safety-check diagrams */
.water-visual-guide{padding-top:22px}
.water-visual-guide h2:not(:first-child){margin:26px 0 13px}
.water-flow{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:5px;width:100%;overflow-x:auto;padding:3px 1px 12px}
.water-flow-box{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2b4432,#192c22);border:1px solid #5a825d;border-radius:11px;min-width:0;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:12px 8px 11px}
.water-flow-num{display:grid;place-items:center;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:#e8b674;color:#183023;font-size:11px;font-weight:900}
.water-flow-box strong{font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;color:#f4ead6;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.water-flow-box small{font-size:10px;color:#b6d6b5;margin-top:auto}
.water-flow-arrow{align-self:center;color:#ffca87;font-size:24px;font-weight:800}
.water-check-stack{display:grid;gap:10px}
.water-check-card{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;border:1px solid #41604e;background:#1b3128;border-radius:12px;padding:14px}
.water-check-card>span{display:grid;place-items:center;width:36px;min-width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;background:#304b37;color:#efc489;font-size:19px}
.water-check-card b{font-size:13px;color:#eddec0}
.water-check-card p{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.65;margin-top:4px;color:#cfe0d0}
.water-decision{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:11px}
.water-decision>div{border:1px solid;border-radius:12px;padding:13px 11px;min-width:0}
.water-decision-bad{background:#32271f;border-color:#835b46!important}
.water-decision-good{background:#1d3327;border-color:#4f7a57!important}
.water-decision span{display:grid;place-items:center;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid currentColor;margin-bottom:9px;font-size:16px;color:#f3c092}
.water-decision-good span{color:#a9e19e}
.water-decision strong{font-size:12px;line-height:1.35;display:block;color:#fae7c6}
.water-decision p{font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.58;margin-top:8px;color:#e0dfd1}
.water-sources{padding-bottom:16px}
.water-sources a{display:block;padding:10px 0;color:#e5b97b;text-decoration:underline;font-size:12px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.water-next-navigation{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 0 18px}
.water-next-navigation button{height:100%;padding:12px 7px;border:1px solid #576e56;background:#253729;border-radius:10px;color:#f1cc94;font-size:12px;line-height:1.35;font-weight:700}
.water-next-navigation span{color:#c2d3b8;white-space:nowrap;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.article-screen .readable-step>p{white-space:pre-line}
.article-screen .readable-step .step-image{border-radius:12px}
@media(max-width:370px){.water-flow-box{padding:10px 6px}.water-flow-box strong{font-size:11px}.water-decision{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
